title: 1987 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: The smallest product one could obtain by multiplying two numbers in the set \(\{ -7, -5, -1, 1, 3 \}\) is

solutions.text:
A negative product comes from multiplying a negative number by a positive number, and it is most negative when both factors are largest in size.

The most negative product is \((-7)(3) = -21.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: The smallest product is the most negative one, which comes from one negative and one positive factor
Pair the most negative number with the largest positive number
